meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能按你给的时间段（没给时默认过去7天）找出那几天的会议，读取每场会议的会议记录和逐字稿链接，整理成汇总：单日给“今日会议概览”，多日给“会议纪要周报”；你要求时还能生成或更新云文档。
howto.when: 该技能仅在 user 身份下使用；当你要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报或回顾一段时间内的会议内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要，生成会议周报。
say.note: 会输出本周的“会议纪要周报”。

say.text: 看看今天开了哪些会，帮我整理个概览。
say.note: 会查“今天”的会议并输出“今日会议概览”。

say.text: 把过去7天的会议纪要整理成一份文档。
say.note: 会把报告保存到新建的云文档。

howto.what_en: Claude finds meetings in the given date range (defaults to past 7 days), gets each meeting's minutes and transcript links, and outputs a single-day overview or weekly report. On request it creates or updates a cloud document.
howto.when_en: Only under a user identity. Triggered when you ask to compile meeting minutes, generate a meeting weekly report, or review meeting content over a period.

say_en.text: Help me compile this week's meeting notes and make a weekly report.
say_en.note: Outputs this week's meetings as a weekly report.

say_en.text: What meetings did we have today? Make an overview.
say_en.note: Searches today's meetings and shows a single-day overview.

say_en.text: Turn the last 7 days of meeting notes into a document.
say_en.note: Creates a cloud document with the summary.
